issues.issue: Automated flag 'uncited number 12' is a false positive — 12 refers to Week 12, a timepoint not an efficacy figure.
Automated flag 'uncited number 2' is a false positive — the 2 comes from the trial name 'OASIS 2', not an efficacy/safety value.
Automated flags 'uncited numbers 2 and 12' are false positives — they derive from 'OASIS 2' and 'Week 12', not from efficacy figures.
Automated flag 'uncited number 2025' is a false positive — it is the approval year (date), and the initial U.S. Approval 2025 is supported elsewhere in the card.
